title: Reply: transforming experience does not block insight into it

statements.text: Altering experience by training is consistent with gaining insight into it, unless experience is a static given. First-person methods intensify self-awareness already present in experience, making it less intrusive and more stable. How far results from trained subjects generalize remains an empirical question.

sources.quote: There is not necessarily any inconsistency between altering or transforming experience
the generality of results from phenomenologically trained subjects remains open as an empirical matter
